answer: At the zenith of each cycle, only identities whose plume of attestations spans diverse independent peers retain full weight; isolated clusters lose stake. Each agent must stake a bond that decays by a fixed delta per epoch unless refreshed by verified peer attestations. A sybil farm must fund many bonds and receive genuine cross-peer trust, making forgery costlier than legitimate participation. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
